new_here: market breadth timing of the U50 index (share of names above their own 50-day mean)
cross-sectional dispersion timing of the U50 index

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.

segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid; trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding; ADR 0041 calibrated cost; wide_universe_dev.pick quintiles for FIP1

trials.BR1_BREADTH_U50: breadth = share of U50 names (with >= 40 closes in cut-49..cut) whose close[cut] > mean close over cut-49..cut; if breadth > 0.5 hold the equal-weight U50 long (1/n each), else flat
trials.DS1_DISPERSION_U50: disp_d = cross-sectional stdev of U50 daily returns on day d; D = mean disp over cut-13..cut; if D < median of the same 14-day mean over the 180 days ending at cut (window ends cut-13*k not needed: rolling 14-day means over cut-179..cut, >= 120 values) hold the equal-weight U50 long, else flat
trials.FIP1_FROGPAN_U50: PRET = close[cut]/close[cut-89]-1; ID = sign(PRET) * (share of negative-return days - share of positive-return days) over cut-89..cut (>= 60 valid); signal = z(PRET) - z(ID) across U50 (cross-sectional z); long the HIGHEST quintile, short the LOWEST (pick)

decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0106; DSR N=3 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 reported
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +3 regardless.
